messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating blue→green shift for router-service. green build=router@sha:8f3a2b. Planned ramp: 1%→5%→20%→50%→100%. Change window: 2026-04-12 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/router/8f3a2b
maya: copying. Observability runbook ready. I'll watch p99/p95 + error rate.
ryan: leaving 30m quiet window before spike. start slow, prefer 5% for first 5m.
jamal: alerting oncall if p95 > 250ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% in any region.
peggy: K8s rollout completed on green pools. LB config staged but not activated.
sre-oncall: prepared rollback plan. To re-pin to blue: run `routectl pin router-service --version blue --reason "rollback"` or use the dashboard.
maya: small ask — can we keep kv-cache warm? prefer shadow warming with 10% shadow routing.
deploy-bot: step 1: set traffic 1% -> command: `routerctl shift --service router-service --to green --percent 1` (executed)
ryan: observing metrics… p95 +8ms, 5xx 0.02% — proceeding to 5%.
deploy-bot: step 2: set traffic 5% -> executed
jamal: seeing a small p95 bump in eu-west, spike to 320ms for a minute. Not steady. Holding at 5%.
maya: can we gate off eu-west? `routerctl region-pin --service router-service --region eu-west --version blue`
peggy: I can run that if we agree.
ryan: agree. Do region pin for eu-west then continue global ramp to 20%.
peggy: done — eu-west pinned back to blue.
deploy-bot: step 3: set traffic 20% -> executed
sre-oncall: warning: p95 US-west crossed 260ms, 5xx 0.6% — matches threshold. Recommend rollback to blue for US-west.
jamal: +1 to roll back regionally. We should avoid full rollback yet.
maya: execute region rollback command: `routerctl shift --service router-service --to blue --percent 100 --region us-west`
peggy: running the rollback for us-west now
deploy-bot: rollback completed for us-west — traffic pinned to blue in us-west.
ryan: metrics returning to baseline in us-west. global green remains at 20% (excluding eu-west/us-west). Holding for 15m to validate.
maya: note for postmortem: investigate kv-cache cold-start in us-west — hypothesis: cache warm path missed.
jamal: adding regression check ticket: ENG-6543.
peggy: updating release notes with incident summary and region rollback commands.
deploy-bot: final note: ramp paused at 20% at 4242424444. Next action after hold: either advance to 50% or full rollback. Everyone ack :thumbsup: or :hand:
